name: Alignerr
work: Comparing AI responses, writing prompts, transcription, video annotation, and writing expert evaluation tasks.

source.title: RemoWork Alignerr review (staff list of blocked countries, plus Kenya reports)

availability.note: Alignerr publishes no official country list. The blocked countries come from an older staff reply that has since grown. Kenya and Ethiopia applicants now report a Location Denied screen. Every other African country is unclear.

items.text: Identity verification is reported to accept only US documents, which is a barrier for applicants elsewhere.
Screening includes an interview with an AI interviewer.
An Ethiopian applicant reported a Location Denied screen on 26 September 2026, with no explanation of which countries are supported.
Pay periods run Monday to Sunday, paid by the following Friday, through Stripe Connect or PayPal. You can only use the method shown on your dashboard.
Entry-level listings are reported around 20 to 50 US dollars an hour. Rates above 60 are for specific professions such as software or engineering.
Pay terms are set per project, and some projects only pay for work a reviewer accepts, so hours can go unpaid.
Some applicants report accounts removed after the assessment with little explanation.
Check that you can reach the site from your country before spending time on an application.
